Name: Pokemon Day Care - Pets
Author: Parme69
Description:
[size=5][b]Pokemon Day Care - Pets[/b][/size]

Trade your cat or dog for a Pokemon partner who grows up with you.

[b]Choose your starter[/b]
[list]
[*]Character creation offers "Starter Preference" instead of the cat and dog: the 27 starters of every generation (Grass, Fire and Water), plus Pichu and Eevee. The vanilla pets are still there if you want them.[/*]
[*]Marnie brings your Pokemon to the farm, in her own little scene, and you give it a name.[/*]
[*]Each Pokemon has its own cry when you pet it.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Evolution[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Friendship[/b]: at 400 then 800 friendship points, your pet evolves overnight (Bulbasaur, Ivysaur, Venusaur...).[/*]
[*][b]Evolution stones[/b]: Pikachu becomes Raichu (Thunder Stone) or Alolan Raichu (Shiny Stone), Eevee becomes any of its 8 evolutions. You're always asked before it happens.[/*]
[*][b]Mega Stones[/b]: Venusaur, Charizard (X and Y), Blastoise, Sceptile, Blaziken and Swampert can Mega Evolve. Use the stone again to go back.[/*]
[*][b]Everstone[/b]: keep your pet at its current stage, as long as you like.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Gifts[/b]
[list]
[*]Each morning, your pet may leave you a gift. The more it loves you, the better the gifts.[/*]
[*]Every type has its own gifts, and a type gem at max friendship (Emerald, Ruby, Aquamarine, Topaz, Amethyst, Obsidian, Diamond, Opal, Jade).[/*]
[*]With Pokemon Day Care, pets bring energies, petals, herbs and terrain seeds instead.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Where to find the stones[/b] (without Pokemon Day Care)
[list]
[*]Clint: Fire, Thunder and Shiny Stones[/*]
[*]Pierre: Leaf, Sun Stones and Everstone[/*]
[*]Willy: Water Stone[/*]
[*]Adventurer's Guild: Ice and Moon Stones[/*]
[*]Krobus: Dawn Stone[/*]
[*]Dwarf: Venusaurite, Charizardite X and Y, Blastoisinite[/*]
[*]Sandy: Sceptilite, Blazikenite, Swampertite[/*]
[/list]Every evolution item is used up when you use it.


[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[*]Pokemon Day Care (optional)[/*]
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]
Unzip into your Mods folder: you get two folders, the content pack and Pets Evolution.

[b]Updating from an older version:[/b] the mod IDs changed to Parme.PokemonDayCarePets and Parme.PokemonDayCarePetsEvolution. Delete the old folders before installing. A Pokemon pet adopted with an older version won't be recognised: start a new save or adopt again.

[b]Pokemon Day Care series[/b]
This mod is part of the Pokemon Day Care series but does not need the main mod.

Downloads.Description:
Delete the old folder before installing; your settings go back to default.
Use it with or without Pokemon Day Care expansion
